DeepMind, Meta AI, and Anthropic co-publish a Monday joint preprint (arxiv 2605.06342) proposing a common signed-checkpoint format with reference implementations in Python and Rust plus formal compositional safety proofs covering the seven CVE pattern instances. NHS England's five-CVE blocklist holds; cross-vendor Defender-protected estates exceed 68 percent control-plane visibility.
